concept: A before/after that becomes a journey. Open on the friction (a model too big for one machine), size the stakes with a hard split, state the mechanism (it splits the layers across the mesh), watch the peers connect, then TRAVEL through the distributed pipeline in one unbroken camera move -- the money shot -- and land on one endpoint. Close on the wordmark holding the after-state. The mesh is felt as a journey, never drawn as a diagram.
money_shot_note: Scene 5, the oner: a single sustained camera glide through the pipeline (your prompt in, peers holding the layers, the answer out). It is the peak because it is the ONE thing only mesh-llm does -- a model living across machines -- shown as motion you travel through, not an architecture slide.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts throughout (the invisible pro default). The one reserved effect, push, fires only on the cut INTO the oner (scene 5), a physical shove into the flythrough. No swipe/whoosh between scenes.
music_direction: Electronic bed with forward momentum; the transient (tapestop_drop) is spent once, as the drop into the oner money shot.
